data.title: The card Sam kept
data.goal: Report a known allergy, name the recorded substance and ask for the record to be checked.

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 牙科候诊椅旁，卡片最初在包前袋
memoryNodes.cue: What known information do you bring?

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 牙科接待台旁电脑左侧
memoryNodes.cue: Which exact name are you pointing to?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 你指的是哪个确切名称？

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 同一电脑屏幕，名称读回后确认
memoryNodes.cue: What should be checked before the visit starts?

data.situation: On the day of his dental appointment, Sam checked in and took a seat opposite the dental desk. He kept a small allergy card in the front pocket of his bag. It listed a reaction to one particular antibiotic, including the exact name. When the nurse came to check his details, Sam put the card on the tray beside her computer. “I am allergic to this antibiotic,” he said, pointing to the name. He was reporting a known allergy, not saying that every medicine in that category had caused the same reaction. Sam asked the nurse to check the allergy record before the appointment began. She read the name back and checked it against the information on the screen. Sam listened carefully; one missing word would change what he was reporting. The card stayed on the tray until the details had been confirmed. Only then did he return it to his bag. The useful part of the sentence was not a complicated description. It was the clear connection between himself, the exact substance and the record the staff needed to see.
data.zhSupport: 包前袋中的过敏卡 → 电脑旁卡片托盘 → 核对后的信息屏幕。先说明事实，再核对不清楚的信息。
data.easySummary: Sam shows a card with an exact medicine name. He reports a known allergy and asks the nurse to check it.
data.easySummaryZh: 萨姆出示写有确切药物名称的卡片，告知已知过敏情况并请求核对。

glossary.note: 形容词，be allergic to + 具体物质；此处是已知医疗信息，不是幽默地表达厌恶。
glossary.example: I am allergic to this antibiotic.

glossary.note: 名词；allergy to + 具体物质，与allergic形容词结构分开。源记录空字段保持，解释为项目辅助。
glossary.example: My allergy is listed on this card.
glossary.exampleZh: 我的过敏信息列在这张卡上。

glossary.note: 本课为名词，识别已记录的药物类别；不由此判断是否应该使用或停止药物。
glossary.example: The name of the antibiotic is on my card.
glossary.exampleZh: 抗生素的名称写在我的卡上。

glossary.note: be随主语变化；to后接过敏原或具体药物名称，不用with替代to。
glossary.example: I am allergic to this antibiotic.
matchTexts: I am allergic to this antibiotic.

glossary.note: 名词allergy前用an；have an allergy to与be allergic to表达同类信息，按需要选一种。
glossary.example: I have an allergy to this antibiotic.
glossary.exampleZh: 我对这种抗生素有过敏反应。
matchTexts: I have an allergy to this antibiotic.

glossary.note: 先说需要核对的信息，再给出后续动作；before不是命令更换治疗。
glossary.example: Could you check my allergy record before we start?
glossary.exampleZh: 您能在开始前核对我的过敏记录吗？
matchTexts: Could you check my allergy record before we start?

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your card records an allergy to the exact medicine you are pointing at. State this information.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 卡上记录你对所指的具体药物过敏。告知这一已知情况。
acceptableAnswers: I am allergic to this antibiotic.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use allergic to and identify the exact substance.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 使用allergic to；指出确切物质。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Use the noun for the same known reaction, referring to the medicine shown on the card.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 换用名词结构表达同一已知过敏情况，指向卡上的药物。
acceptableAnswers: I have an allergy to this antibiotic.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use an before the singular noun and to before the substance.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The visit is about to start. Ask the nurse to check the recorded allergy first.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 会面即将开始，请护士先核对过敏记录。
acceptableAnswers: Could you check my allergy record before we start?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask for a record check, not a medication decision.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 请求核对记录；说明应在开始前完成。

transferPrompt.cue: At a restaurant, you have a known allergy to peanuts. Tell the server and ask for your allergy note to be checked before the food is prepared.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到餐厅：你已知对花生过敏。告知服务员，并请其在备餐前核对过敏备注。
acceptableAnswers: I am allergic to peanuts. Could you check my allergy note before preparing the food?
transferPrompt.feedback: Change the substance and event while keeping the clear report.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 替换物质与事件；保留明确告知和核对请求。
